statement.p: Find the solution {\bf r\it(t)} of the differential equation with the given initial condition:

static.solution:
\bf r\it'(t) to find the general solution:
\bf r\it(t)=\int \left\lt \sin 2 t,\sin 9 t,3 t\right> \,dt
= \left\lt \int \sin 2 t dt,\int \sin 9 t dt,\int 3 t dt\right> = \left\lt -\frac{1}{2}\cos 2 t,-\frac{1}{9}\cos 9 t,\frac{3}{2} t^2\right> + \bf c\it Substituting the initial condition we obtain:
\bf r\it(0)=\left\lt -\frac{1}{2}\cos 0,-\frac{1}{9}\cos 0,\frac{3}{2} 0^2\right> + \bf c\it
= \left\lt 9,9,8\right> = \left\lt -\frac{1}{2},-\frac{1}{9},0\right> + \bf c\it Hence,
\bf c\it=\left\lt 9,9,8\right> - \left\lt -\frac{1}{2},-\frac{1}{9},0\right> = \left\lt \frac{19}{2},\frac{82}{9},8\right> Hence the solution to the differential equation with the given initial condition is:
\bf r\it(t)=\left\lt -\frac{1}{2}\cos 2 t,-\frac{1}{9}\cos 9 t,\frac{3}{2} t^2\right> + \left\lt \frac{19}{2},\frac{82}{9},8\right>
=\left\lt \frac{1}{2}\left(19-\cos 2 t\right), \frac{1}{9}\left(82-\cos 9 t\right), 8+\frac{3}{2} t^2\right>
